Who We Are: 

 Exiger is the AI partner for supply chain and procurement automation. Its centralized 1EXIGER.AI platform allows organizations to manage their entire operating network, from parts to suppliers, regulators, and customers, through an autonomous agentic workforce that learns, adapts, and augments with every decision. The AI-native platform, combined with the largest supply chain knowledge asset, empowers 550+ global customers, including 150 Fortune 500 and 80+ government and defense industrial organizations, to act first. Exiger is FedRAMP® authorized and a 2x Leader in Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management.

 Forward Deployed Data Engineer   

 Role Summary 

 Exiger is seeking a technical, customer-focused Forward Deployed Data Engineer to bridge the gap between complex customer data environments and Exiger’s supply chain risk management solutions. This role combines hands-on data engineering, technical problem-solving, and direct customer engagement to accelerate data integration, improve data quality, and deliver actionable supply chain intelligence.   

   As a Forward Deployed Data Engineer, you will work closely with customers and cross-functional Exiger teams to design scalable data pipelines, resolve complex data challenges, implement custom integrations, and support advanced supply chain risk assessments. You will play a critical role in ensuring customers can effectively leverage Exiger’s technology to identify supply chain vulnerabilities, assess supplier risks, and make informed business decisions.   

   The ideal candidate thrives in dynamic, customer-facing environments, possesses strong data engineering and analytical capabilities, and can translate complex technical challenges into scalable solutions that deliver measurable customer value.   

 What You Will Do   

 
 Design and Build Scalable Data Pipelines: Develop, implement, and maintain reusable data processing workflows to ingest, validate, normalize, transform, and enrich customer supplier, part, material, and Bill of Materials (BOM) data. Establish automated processes that minimize manual intervention and support enterprise-scale data volumes.   

 
 
 Accelerate Data Integration and Reconciliation: Identify and resolve data quality issues, mapping gaps, and discrepancies between customer data and Exiger’s platform. Collaborate directly with customers to streamline ingestion, improve data accuracy, and accelerate the delivery of actionable results.   

 
 
 Develop and Support Custom Integrations : Configure, implement, and troubleshoot customer-specific integrations, APIs, and data exchange workflows. Design solutions that accommodate complex customer environments while ensuring data integrity, reliability, and scalability.   

 
 
 Support Advanced Supply Chain Analysis: Conduct expedited analysis of parts, materials, and BOMs to identify critical material dependencies, supply chain vulnerabilities, provenance gaps, and supplier-level risks. Prioritize high-impact analyses based on customer objectives and business requirements.   

 
 
 Validate and Translate Risk Intelligence : Review flagged supply chain risks, validate supporting data and evidence, and collaborate with subject matter experts to translate complex findings into actionable assessments and recommendations.   

 
 
 Serve as a Technical Customer Partner : Act as a trusted technical resource for customers, proactively identifying and resolving technical challenges, optimizing data workflows, and ensuring successful adoption of Exiger’s solutions.   

 
 
 Collaborate with Product and Engineering : Partner with Exiger’s Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Customer Success teams to troubleshoot technical issues, develop scalable solutions, and advocate for product enhancements based on customer requirements and emerging use cases.   

 
 
 Drive Continuous Improvement and Automation : Identify opportunities to improve data processing efficiency, reduce manual workflows, and standardize repeatable technical solutions across customer engagements. Document technical processes, integrations, and best practices to enable scalability.   

 
 What You Need   

 Required Qualifications   

 
 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.   

 
 
 5+ years of professional experience in data engineering, software engineering, solutions engineering, or a related technical role.   

 
 
 Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, including experience developing data transformation, validation, and automation workflows.   

 
 
 Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and processing large, complex datasets.   

 
 
 Experience integrating disparate data sources through APIs, structured data exchanges, and custom integration workflows.   

 
 
 Strong understanding of data modeling, data normalization, data quality management, and reconciliation techniques.   

 
 
 Experience working with structured and semi-structured data formats, including JSON, CSV, XML, and relational databases.   

 
 
 Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues, identify root causes, and implement scalable, sustainable solutions.   

 
 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex datasets and identify meaningful insights.   

 
 
 Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.   

 
 
 Experience collaborating directly with customers or external stakeholders to gather requirements, resolve technical challenges, and deliver solutions.   

 
 
 Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment, manage competing priorities, and balance immediate customer needs with long-term technical scalability.   

 
 Preferred Qualifications   

 
 Experience in a Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Customer Engineer, or Technical Consultant role supporting enterprise customers.   

 
 
 Familiarity with supply chain management, supply chain risk management (SCRM), third-party risk management (TPRM), or supplier intelligence solutions.   

 
 
 Experience working with Bill of Materials (BOM), part-level data, supplier master data, or manufacturing and procurement datasets.   

 
 
 Knowledge of supply chain risk factors, including critical mineral dependencies, supplier concentration, geographic exposure, and material provenance.   

 
 
 Experience with cloud-based data platforms and infrastructure, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.   

 
 
 Familiarity with modern data engineering technologies such as Databricks, Snowflake, Airflow, or dbt.   

 
 
 Experience developing automated data validation, monitoring, and exception-handling frameworks.   

 
 
 Familiarity with enterprise integration patterns, REST APIs, and data orchestration tools.   

 
 
 Experience leveraging AI/ML technologies, including large language models (LLMs), to automate data enrichment, entity resolution, or analytical workflows.   

 
 
 Experience supporting enterprise-scale deployments involving complex data environments, multiple stakeholders, and evolving technical requirements.   

 
 
 Understanding of data governance, security, and compliance considerations when handling sensitive customer information.   

 
 
 Experience translating customer feedback and technical requirements into actionable product enhancements in collaboration with Product and Engineering teams.   

 
  #LI-Hybrid 

  
 Exiger is named a Leader in the Gartner ®  Magic Quadrant™ for Supplier Risk Management, twice selected as one of Fast Company's 'Brands That Matter,' and recipient of the Third Party Risk Association's Innovator Award, Exiger's technology has been recognized by leading analyst evaluations and 50+ awards. Learn more at  Exiger.com  and follow Exiger on  LinkedIn .

 At Exiger, our values define how we work and why we lead. We are mission-inspired, imagination-driven, trust-anchored, and compassion-focused—committed to building technology that makes the world safer, more transparent, and more resilient.

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or protected veteran status, or any other legally protected basis, in accordance with applicable law.

 Exiger’s hybrid work policy is periodically reviewed and adjusted to align with evolving business needs.
